method: Toyota official front/rear photographs were visually compared with original native Three.js geometry. No third-party photograph is redistributed or used as a vehicle skin. Dimensions and wheel sizes match vehicles.mjs; surface curves, trim placement, paint colours and the simplified interior visible through the windscreen are estimates, not OEM CAD.

features: low wedge bonnet and fastback roof
angular headlamp housings and LED edges
split rear hatch glass and vertical tail lamps
separate door windows, pillars, mirrors and panel gaps
chrome-block grille, three projector lamps and corner fog recesses
sliding door tracks, chrome window belt and privacy glass
layered horizontal rear lamps, spoiler and rear wiper
